gpu0.name: timing_spacing_log_aug_refine
cmds: python -c "import time,torch,numpy as np; from benchmark.infer import build_model, predict_roi; m=build_model('spacing_lora','$OUT/checkpoints/timing_a/model.pth',refine=True,device='cuda',spacing_encoding='log'); [ (lambda s: (lambda t: (predict_roi(m,np.random.randint(0,60000,(s,s,s)).astype(np.uint16),5.2,128,'cuda'), print('patch128 native', s, round(time.time()-t,1),'s', flush=True)))(time.time()))(s) for s in (192,640)]; t=time.time(); predict_roi(m,np.random.randint(0,60000,(640,640,640)).astype(np.uint16),5.2,128,'cuda',resample_um=50.0); print('patch128 fov50 640', round(time.time()-t,1),'s')"
